scope: Reference-only scientific oracle for independent Lead/Challenger/Investigator/Judge live behavior audits; these expected outcomes MUST NOT be passed to the agents.

cases.scenario: A decisive criterion demands a two-sided exact paired sign test with n=3 non-tied independent pairs and alpha=0.025. Can any possible observation meet it?
cases.review_focus: Flag unattainable significance as qualification design issue; an exploratory inconclusive result can still be legitimate if explicitly scoped.

cases.scenario: n=8 non-tied pairs, two-sided exact paired sign test, alpha=0.025. Is threshold logically reachable? Does that alone establish adequate statistical power?
cases.review_focus: Distinguish logical reachability from study power and from proof of the scientific hypothesis.

cases.scenario: Proposed decisive claim is strictly positive effect; measured effect 0.004 with rigorous absolute error bound 0.01.
cases.review_focus: Do not declare a strictly positive effect while zero is inside the defensible interval.

cases.scenario: Claim is strictly positive effect with an exact conservative error bound; measured effect 0.004 with rigorous absolute error bound 0.0001.
cases.review_focus: Sign is distinguishable under these stated error assumptions; does not imply broader generalization.

cases.scenario: A universal deterministic theorem is proposed; a valid explicit counterexample disproves it without sampling.
cases.review_focus: Do not require p-values, sample sizes or irrelevant baselines for a rigorous counterexample.

live_audit_requirement: Run fresh real Agent evaluations without oracle in input; archive full trace, frozen Goal/H/decisive test, Agent decisions and independent reviewer evidence. Passing this oracle unittest alone never proves real Agent science.
